sloka: पाणिभिर्निहताः केचित् केचिज्जानुभिराहताः ।प्रकृष्टाश्च यथाकामं देवमार्गं च दर्शिताः ।। ५.६३.९ ।।।।
transliteration: pāṇibhirnihatāḥ kecit kecijjānubhirāhatāḥ ।prakṛṣṭāśca yathākāmaṁ devamārgaṁ ca darśitāḥ ।। 5.63.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "Some were struck with hands, some beaten on their knees and were dragged as they liked and showed up their private parts.
